TestBootstrap::test_reject_node_bootstra.description: 3 nodes in 3 racks, insert 1000 rows RF=3 at CL=ALL, full cluster stop; restart only node1+node2, start new node4 and expect it to fail with 'topology coordinator rejected request to join' / 'banned from the cluster' (node3 down). Then start node3, wipe node4 and start it again (must succeed), stop node3, read all keys via node4 at QUORUM. Guards that a join is rejected while a member is down after full-cluster restart (scylla-dtest#2858, scylladb/scylladb PR 11425) and that the rejected node can retry.
